title: Three different fire/oil items (a jug of pitch-oil, a cask of Ironbound oil, a skin of Ironbound pitch) were carried the entire game, each flavor-texted for burning a hollow ('meant for burning a hollow clean' / 'meant for burning what won't rest') — none was ever consumed by any burn action. Both hollows I actually burned (the Gallows Glade, the Kings' Rest hearth-stone) resolved through a bare might-check with text like 'You don't wait on pitch,' leaving all three oils sitting unused in the final inventory.
where: The Gallows Glade / 'burn it — a failed try costs 1hp (might)'; The Kings' Rest — the Old Court / 'shatter the hearth-stone (might)'
